result.title: DSRS: Teaching MLLMs to Perceive, Reason, and Segment in Complex Driving Scenes
result.summary: Existing reasoning segmentation frameworks typically employ multimodal large language models (MLLMs) with broad world knowledge to extract semantics in a human-like manner and generate corresponding segmentation masks. Nevertheless, these frameworks lack the necessary scene-specific awareness. This paper introduces driving scene reasoning segmentation (DSRS), a scene-specific task that requires models to interpret implicit instructions, infer spatial relations, detect potential risks, handle challenging conditions, and comprehend underlying traffic rules, ultimately generating accurate segmentation masks. Meanwhile, we establish a benchmark dataset to facilitate future research on the DSRS task. To pioneer this task, we propose DSRS-Net, a novel architecture with advanced reasoning segmentation capability for automated driving. Specifically, DSRS-Net seamlessly infuses geometric features for deeper reasoning segmentation, without compromising the original multimodal fusion mechanism. This strategy effectively mitigates the modality representation mismatch in MLLMs caused by RGB-only pretraining, while enhancing the integration of geometric, contextual, and linguistic features. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superior performance of DSRS-Net in both driving scene reasoning segmentation and other language-driven segmentation tasks across various public datasets. The source code and dataset will be released upon publication.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出驾驶场景推理分割任务 DSRS 及配套基准，要求模型理解隐含指令、推断空间关系与交通规则并输出分割掩码，并提出 DSRS-Net，在 MLLM 多模态融合中注入几何特征以提升推理分割效果。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「几何特征注入以缓解 RGB-only 预训练造成的模态表示失配」可供核查 LVR 中几何与任务必要视觉细节是否保留在内部状态的问题，但方法本身面向分割输出，未涉及 latent 推理状态生成。
